Name: Ahuzzath
Summary: Ahuzzath was a friend of Abimelech, king of Gerar, who came with the king and Phichol to make a covenant with Isaac.
KeyStory: Ahuzzath witnessed the treaty at Beersheba, where Abimelech admitted that God was plainly with Isaac.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, King of Gerar; Phichol; Isaac
LifeLesson: Even bystanders can see when God is with someone.
